project.name: LinkFinder AI
project.facts:
LinkFinder AI turns a name, company, email or LinkedIn URL into a verified business email or phone number. Plans start at $49/month for 5,000 credits. A LinkedIn-profile-to-email lookup costs 10 credits. There is a Google Sheets add-on, a Zapier app and a public API.

The outbound service: we build the prospect list, write the campaign, run the sending, handle the replies, and the meeting lands in your calendar. You pay per meeting held.

campaign.name: organismes de formation FR/BE/LU
campaign.offer: Outbound run end to end, paid per meeting held.
campaign.customer_problem: Prospecting stops whenever the team is delivering training, so the pipeline arrives in waves.

prompts.instructions: Ask for a reply, not a call. Never mention a discount. Name the pay-per-meeting model once — it is the whole reason this offer is different — and do not explain it twice.
New angle each time. Follow-up 1: the cost of waiting a quarter. Follow-up 2: offer a sample list of 20 prospects, free, no call needed.
Only facts from Project docs. No pressure. If they ask about price, answer plainly with the pay-per-meeting model. Send the booking link only once they have shown real interest.
